# opnsense_acme_certificate (Resource)

Manages an os-acme-client certificate. Certificate/account private keys stay endpoint-local. `issue` performs the explicit ACME issuance lifecycle action; bump `issuance_version` to retry or force renewal.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `validation_id` (String)

### Optional

- `alias_mode` (String)
- `alt_names` (Set of String)
- `auto_renewal` (Boolean)
- `challenge_alias` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `issuance_version` (Number)
- `issue` (Boolean)
- `key_length` (String)
- `renew_interval` (Number)
- `restart_action_ids` (Set of String)

### Read-Only

- `cert_ref_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `issued` (Boolean)
- `last_update` (String)
- `status_code` (String)
- `status_last_update` (String)
